pitch.short: I spent two and a half years in market research at TBRC, on 55+ reports that brought in ₹1.9 Cr+ in sales. Since then I have worked with crowds, from running the Masters' Union zone at HYROX Delhi (10,500 athletes) to an IPL auction draft for 60 classmates. I grew up in Hyderabad, and I want to put the research and the crowd work together for the Orange Army.
why_hire: I start from the numbers: 55+ market research reports at TBRC, ₹1.9 Cr+ in report sales and a green hydrogen database of 600+ projects that sold ₹17L+.
I've run the room: ran the Masters' Union zone at HYROX Delhi (10,500 athletes), 10+ esports tournaments for 250+ players, and an IPL auction draft for 60 participants on a ₹5K budget.
I've built launch plans for sport: a ₹50L go-to-market plan for NIVIA's India jersey, and an off-season plan for goSTOPS that finished in the top 5 of 93 teams.

one-orange-army.context: The Sunrisers group plays in three leagues: Sunrisers Eastern Cape in SA20 (January–February), Sunrisers Hyderabad in the IPL (March–May) and Sunrisers Leeds in The Hundred (July–August). Eastern Cape has won 3 titles in 4 seasons, and the Leeds women's team started 2026 as champions.
one-orange-army.problem: Hyderabad's fan calendar is built around one IPL window. The other two teams play when the Orange Army has nothing to cheer for, so the group has year-round cricket but not yet year-round fans.
one-orange-army.my_role: Independent concept: the idea, the research and the pilot plan
what_i_did: Mapped the three seasons against India's clock: South Africa is 3.5 hours behind IST, and Hundred men's games (2:30–6:30 pm UK) land at about 7–11 pm in India.
Designed Orange Army Nights: watch-alongs for Eastern Cape and Leeds matches at Hyderabad venues and campuses, run like a home game with screens, chants and a host.
Added a second screen: short local-creator reels that introduce 'your other Sunrisers', plus a live watch-along stream for fans at home.
Designed the Orange Army Passport: a card stamped at every Night, with stamps that carry into the IPL season.
Costed a pilot from published rate guides: LED walls at ₹5K–15K a day and nano creators at ₹2K–8K a reel.

decisions.choice: Pilot in SA20 2027, before the IPL
decisions.why: Season 5 runs 17 January to 21 February 2027, so the pilot's numbers are in before the IPL opener and before any decision on Leeds.

decisions.choice: Start with venues that already screen SRH games
decisions.why: Hyderabad venues such as The Game Palacio in HITEC City already run SRH screenings, so the pilot asks them to do the same for Eastern Cape games instead of building anything new.
Stamps are redeemed at the IPL opener, so following the other two teams earns the fan something in their own stadium.

results.note: plus a host; a planning estimate from published rate guides, not quotes
fans per Night, Passport sign-ups, Indian follows of SEC and Leeds, reel views, stamps redeemed

one-orange-army.learned: SA20 is already looking for Indian fans: league-wide TV viewership grew 37% in season 3, and the league held an SA20 India Day in Mumbai.
one-orange-army.next: Read the pilot numbers in March, then decide whether to run Leeds Nights in July.

nivia-india-jersey.context: NIVIA, an Indian sports brand founded in 1934, became the national football team's kit maker in 2026. Fans already buy unofficial jerseys at about ₹999, while official premium jerseys sit at ₹4,299–7,999.
nivia-india-jersey.problem: Demand exists, but official supply is the gap. The job was to capture fans who already care and remove the friction of finding and affording the real shirt, without trying to outspend adidas.
nivia-india-jersey.my_role: Led the work end to end: research, segments, pricing, budget and sales model (team project)
what_i_did: Sized the opportunity from public data: 157.2M ISL unique viewers in 2024–25, up 18% year on year.
Split the range into three kits for three fans: Home for the match fan, Away for the style fan, Training for the young player.
Built a price ladder that beats the fake, not adidas: ₹899 kids, ₹1,499 terrace, ₹2,499 match and ₹4,999 cap edition.
Created the 'Wear the Blue. Earn your number.' platform: every jersey gets a unique number and a QR claim, with a live city leaderboard.
Split the ₹50L budget across performance (₹12L), creators (₹11L), tournaments (₹9L) and out-of-home (₹8L).

decisions.why: The white space sits between ₹999 unofficial shirts and premium official ones, so the hero price zone is ₹1,499–2,499.

decisions.choice: Seed with match fans, scale with style fans
decisions.why: Football credibility has to come first; the Gen Z style fan brings volume once the shirt is seen as the real one.

decisions.choice: Turn the shirt into a registered number
decisions.why: A jersey is easy to copy and a registered fan number is not. It also creates first-party data and a reason to buy the next kit.

results.note: match fans, style fans and young players

nivia-india-jersey.learned: In fan merchandise the insight was belonging, not price: "I may never play for India. But I can be counted for India."
nivia-india-jersey.next: Roll out in the plan's order: ASEAN Cup, then ISL, then grassroots.

gostops-off-season.context: goSTOPS runs backpacker hostels across India. From April to June its beds are 72.5% full; from July to September only 27.5%, and revenue per available bed falls from ₹775 to ₹300.
gostops-off-season.problem: Guests pay the same rate in July as in May. The whole gap is unsold beds: about 333,000 of 460,000 bed-nights go empty across 5,000 beds and 92 nights.
gostops-off-season.my_role: Presented the team's strategy to the judges (team of four)
what_i_did: We found the blocked variable: in July, travellers lack the time to go, not the willingness to pay.
We built six behavioural segments and picked two whose July is free by calendar: graduates waiting to join their first job, and companies of 30 to 200 people.
We designed 'Batch of '27', a programme for graduates between placement and joining, and 'Whole House' property buyouts for company offsites.
We planned Batch Night every Friday, with a Batch Card stamped at every property.
I presented the plan to the judges.

decisions.why: Anticipation is built where the audience already is, before the quiet season starts.
Nothing gets cheaper: a ₹400 programme and a week with a shape are added on top of the bed.

gostops-off-season.learned: The rate was never the problem. Once the gap was framed as empty beds, not cheap beds, discounting stopped being an option.
gostops-off-season.next: The stamp-at-every-property idea became the Orange Army Passport in my Sunrisers concept.

brief_me.title: Brief me
brief_me.intro: Pick a goal, a budget and the channels you use. The sketch on the right is built from my own work: the case closest to your brief, the format I'd start with and the number I'd watch.

goals.label: Fill the stands
goals.metric: Tickets sold per campaign rupee, by channel
goals.metric_why: It shows which channel puts people in seats, not just which one gets seen.

goals.label: Fans between seasons
goals.metric: Fans who engage with all three teams in a year
goals.metric_why: For a three-team group, the real test is the fan who stays after the IPL ends.

goals.label: Merch or launch
goals.metric: Units sold in the first 90 days
goals.metric_why: A launch is judged by its first quarter; it is the number the NIVIA plan was built around.

budget.label: Budget for the first eight weeks

holdback.text: kept back until the first week shows what works, then put behind it

bands.plan: Small budget: one pilot, like four Nights at venues that already screen matches.
Mid budget: the pilot in two cities or several campuses, with creators added once the first numbers come in.
Large budget: a programme across all three teams' seasons, with paid push only behind what worked.
